requirement:
The model-facing search and `finish_search` tool descriptions MUST give the
same selection guidance as
{cite}`requirements.authoring.search_accounting.instructions`.
rationale:
The subject requires the model-facing search tool descriptions and the `finish_search` description to give the same selection guidance as `requirements.authoring.search_accounting.instructions`. That guidance has these parts:
- Close every delivered search with `finish_search`.
- Submission fails while a search is open.
- Include a tag only if its snippet was used to justify the conclusion without an additional source read.
- Entries whose source was read with habeas may be omitted, and including them is harmless.
- Use `used:[]` when no entries qualify, including for an empty search.
- `finish_search` records dependencies and does not request more source.

`src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[finish_search_advertises_the_accounting_schema_and_selection_rule]` is marked `{test}` for the subject. It builds `definitions()` and checks the `finish_search` description for these phrases:
- "snippets you used to justify your conclusion without an additional source read"
- "Entries whose source you also read may be omitted; including them is harmless"
- "Use used:[] when no entries qualify, including an empty search"
- "Every delivered search must be finished before submission"
- "{search_id, finished:true}"
- "no additional source is delivered"
- the `search_id` and `used` explanation, plus the example call

It also checks the `finish_search` parameter schema.

The test then loops over both search tools, `ripgrep` and `ast_grep`. For each it checks:
- "tags whose snippets you used to justify your conclusion without an additional source read"
- the omit-if-read and "harmless" sentence
- "Use an empty used list if no entries qualify"
- "Before submitting, call finish_search"
- the tool-choice sentence

The assertions are substring checks that name the failing phrase and tool. A description that dropped or changed any of these points would fail the test. These phrases cover every element of the required guidance. "Submission fails while open" appears as "must be finished before submission". "Does not request more source" appears as "no additional source is delivered".

I found no other model-facing search tool, so the loop covers the search tools. The `references`, `outline` and `list_files` tools return no `search_id`. Sibling tests such as `ripgrep_tool_is_advertised_with_its_interface_and_conventions` and `ast_grep_tool_is_advertised_with_both_forms_and_rule_syntax` add further checks of the `finish_search` mentions.

The subject's obligations are tested, and I found no gap.

The `instructions` field supplied under {cite}`requirements.authoring.search_accounting.first_result` MUST contain the following text.

Before submitting your assessment, close every delivered search with finish_search({search_id, used:[tags]}). Submission fails while any search remains open. Include a tag only when you used information in its snippet to justify your conclusion without an additional source read. Entries whose source you subsequently read with habeas may be omitted; including them is harmless. Use used:[] when no entries qualify, including for an empty search. finish_search records dependencies and does not request more source.
